description: Couch-score parity vectors. Generated by tests/gen_score_vectors.mjs from score() in steam-backlog-triage's backlog.html. Each game is in export schema 2 form; implementations normalize it as the page does, then score it with the given lane. vectors use default weights; weightSets re-score the same games under other weights (terms are [key, points]). Do not edit by hand.
